samples.title: Auto load single video src
samples.description: The simplest means of using a dash.js player in a web page. The MPD source is specified within the @src attribute of the video element.

samples.title: Auto load single video
samples.description: The MPD source is specified within the child source element of the video element.

samples.title: Auto load multi video
samples.description: Shows how to auto-embed multiple dash.js player instances on a page.

samples.title: Manual load single video
samples.description: Shows how to manually create and initialize a dash.js player to load a single video.

samples.title: Manual load with custom settings
samples.description: Shows how to initialize a dash.js player with custom settings for logging, scheduling, and buffer management.

samples.title: Using the control bar
samples.description: Shows how to add and configure the control bar with the dash.js player.

samples.title: Listening to events
samples.description: Shows how to listen to events raised by dash.js.

samples.title: Log levels
samples.description: Shows how to configure dash.js logging levels.

samples.title: Load with URL parameters
samples.description: A demo page that uses URL query parameters to configure playback.

samples.title: MPD anchors
samples.description: Shows how to use MPD anchors to start a presentation at a given time.

samples.title: Manual load with start time
samples.description: Shows how to initialize playback at a specific start time.

samples.title: Preload content
samples.description: Shows how to use the preload feature of dash.js, which allows streaming to be initialized and content to start downloading before the player is attached to an HTML5 video element. This can be used to optimize content insertion on platforms that provide only a single decoder.

samples.title: Load with a parsed manifest object
samples.description: Shows how to load the manifest as a parsed object instead of providing a URL to the manifest.

samples.title: Autoplay browser policy
samples.description: Shows how to deal with autoplay browser policies. It uses an event listener to detect when autoplay is interrupted by the browser and recovers from this situation by muting audio.

samples.title: Live delay comparison custom manifest
samples.description: Shows how to use the two settings that control live delay: streaming.delay.liveDelay and streaming.delay.liveDelayFragmentCount.

samples.title: Live delay comparison using liveDelayFragmentCount
samples.description: Shows the combined effects of segment duration and the streaming.delay.liveDelayFragmentCount setting on the latency of live stream playback.

samples.title: Live delay comparison using liveDelay
samples.description: Shows the combined effects of segment duration and the streaming.delay.liveDelay setting on the latency of live stream playback.

samples.title: Dynamic to static transition
samples.description: Shows a live stream transitioning to a final static MPD.

samples.title: Synchronized live playback
samples.description: Shows synchronized live playback of two videos using the live playback catchup mode.

samples.title: Live stream with availabilityTimeOffset
samples.description: Shows how dash.js handles live streams with an availabilityTimeOffset (ATO).

samples.title: Live stream with MPD patching
samples.description: Shows how dash.js handles live streams with updates to the MPD provided via MPD patching.

samples.title: Low latency testplayer
samples.description: Shows how to use dash.js to play low latency streams. All low-latency related settings, such as the different ABR algorithms (LoL+, L2A), are selectable.

samples.title: Changing the default ABR algorithm
samples.description: Shows how to configure the ABR algorithms in dash.js.

samples.title: Custom ABR rules
samples.description: Shows how to create and define custom ABR rules in dash.js.

samples.title: Disable ABR
samples.description: Shows how to disable ABR switching in dash.js.

samples.title: Initial bitrate
samples.description: Shows how to set the initial bitrate in dash.js.

samples.title: Max/min bitrate
samples.description: Shows how to set the maximum and minimum bitrate in dash.js.

samples.title: Fast bitrate switch
samples.description: Shows how to aggressively replace segments in the buffer when switching up to a higher bitrate.

samples.title: Average throughput calculation mode
samples.description: Shows how to change the throughput calculation mode used in dash.js, and displays the calculated throughput as a live metric.

samples.title: Buffer target
samples.description: Shows how to define the buffer targets in dash.js.

samples.title: Buffer cleanup
samples.description: Shows how to define the parameters for buffer cleanup/pruning in dash.js.

samples.title: Initial buffer target
samples.description: Shows how to define the initial buffer target at playback start in dash.js.

samples.title: Widevine DRM
samples.description: Shows how to use dash.js to play streams with Widevine DRM protection.

samples.title: PlayReady DRM
samples.description: Shows how to use dash.js to play streams with PlayReady DRM protection.

samples.title: Fairplay DRM
samples.description: Shows how to use dash.js to play streams with Fairplay DRM protection.

samples.title: Fairplay DRM with external certificate URL
samples.description: Shows how to play Fairplay DRM protected streams with a certificate server URL provided via the API instead of the MPD.

samples.title: ClearKey DRM
samples.description: Shows how to use dash.js to play streams with ClearKey DRM protection.

samples.title: License wrapping
samples.description: Shows how to use dash.js to filter and wrap license requests and responses.

samples.title: Certificate wrapping
samples.description: Shows how to use dash.js to filter and wrap license certificate requests and responses.

samples.title: DRM system priority
samples.description: Shows how to specify a DRM system priority when the underlying platform supports multiple DRM systems.

samples.title: DRM system string priority
samples.description: Shows how to specify the system string priority for the call to requestMediaKeySystemAccess. For example, PlayReady might be supported with the system strings "com.microsoft.playready.recommendation" and "com.microsoft.playready".

samples.title: License server via MPD
samples.description: Shows how to specify the license server URL as part of the MPD using 'dashif:laurl'.

samples.title: Keep MediaKeySession
samples.description: Shows how the ProtectionController and the created MediaKeys and MediaKeySessions are preserved during the MediaPlayer lifetime, leading to fewer license requests.

samples.title: Robustness level
samples.description: Shows how to define a robustness level to be used by dash.js when calling requestMediaKeySystemAccess.

samples.title: Headless license acquisition
samples.description: Acquires a DRM license using the ProtectionController API directly, without video playback. Demonstrates the full EME key session lifecycle.

samples.title: WebVTT captions
samples.description: Shows how content with VTT captions can be played back by the dash.js player. The first captions appear at the 15s mark.

samples.title: CEA 608/708 embedded captions
samples.description: Shows how content with embedded CEA 608/708 captions can be played back by the dash.js player.

samples.title: Multi-track captions
samples.description: Shows content with multiple timed text tracks.

samples.title: TTML EBU timed text tracks
samples.description: Shows content with TTML EBU timed text tracks.

samples.title: WebVTT custom rendering
samples.description: Shows how content with VTT captions can be played back by the dash.js player using the external vtt.js library. This enables VTT support on devices that do not provide native VTT support.

samples.title: Caption event handling
samples.description: Shows how to consume subtitle events raised by dash.js so you can render the subtitles yourself.

samples.title: External WebVTT subtitles
samples.description: Shows how to add external WebVTT subtitles that are not specified in the manifest.

samples.title: Multiple audio tracks
samples.description: Shows how content with multiple audio tracks can be played back by the dash.js player. dash.js allows switching the audio track during playback.

samples.title: Multiple audio tracks with different codecs
samples.description: Shows how content with multiple audio tracks using different codecs can be played back by the dash.js player. dash.js allows switching the audio track during playback.

samples.title: Initial audio track
samples.description: Shows how to select a default audio language for playback.

samples.title: Initial audio track with language and accessibility
samples.description: Shows how to select a default audio language and accessibility for playback.

samples.title: Audio only stream
samples.description: Shows how to play audio-only streams in dash.js.

samples.title: Custom initial track selection
samples.description: Shows how to define your own initial track selection function.

samples.title: Custom capabilities filters
samples.description: Shows how to filter representations by defining a custom capabilities filter function.

samples.title: Custom capabilities filter (Media Capabilities API)
samples.description: Shows how to filter representations asynchronously based on responses from the Media Capabilities API.

samples.title: Thumbnails
samples.description: Shows how to use streams with thumbnail representations.

samples.title: Multiperiod VoD
samples.description: Shows how dash.js handles streams with two periods.

samples.title: Multiperiod live
samples.description: Shows how dash.js handles live streams with multiple periods.

samples.title: Monitoring the stream
samples.description: Shows how to monitor metrics of the streams played by dash.js.

samples.title: Listening to SCTE-EMSG events
samples.description: Shows how to listen to SCTE EMSG events raised by dash.js.

samples.title: Network interceptors
samples.description: Shows how to apply network request and response interceptors based on the Common Media Library API.

samples.title: Flexible insertion of URL parameters
samples.description: Shows how to flexibly insert URL parameters into requests in dash.js.

samples.title: Content steering
samples.description: Illustrates content steering to dynamically switch between CDNs. Note that you need to provide a manifest with a valid content steering server.

samples.title: CMCD v1 reporting
samples.description: Shows how to use dash.js to enhance requests to the CDN with Common Media Client Data (CMCD - CTA-5004).

samples.title: CMCD v1 reporting from manifest
samples.description: Shows how to use dash.js to enhance requests to the CDN with Common Media Client Data (CMCD - CTA-5004), configured from a manifest file.

samples.title: CMCD v2 reporting
samples.description: Shows how to use dash.js to enhance requests to the CDN with Common Media Client Data (CMCD - CTA-5004), including the CMCD v2 event mode.

samples.title: Scalable LCEVC carriage
samples.description: Demonstrates how to use MPEG-5 Part 2 LCEVC for scalable delivery, where higher resolution representations are generated by applying LCEVC to the corresponding lower resolution versions.

samples.title: Scalable LCEVC with debug residuals
samples.description: Demonstrates how to use MPEG-5 Part 2 LCEVC for scalable delivery, where higher resolution representations are generated by applying LCEVC to the corresponding lower resolution versions. This version includes debug residuals, resulting in moving squares when LCEVC is being correctly decoded.

samples.title: LCEVC using SEI carriage
samples.description: Shows how to use MPEG-5 Part 2 LCEVC via SEI carriage to enhance the stream it is included in.

samples.title: Play HEVC streams in any browser
samples.description: Shows how to play HEVC (H.265) DASH streams in dash.js on browsers without native HEVC support — Firefox, Chrome on Linux/Windows, etc. The @hevcjs/dashjs-plugin transcodes HEVC samples to H.264 in a Web Worker (WASM + WebCodecs), transparently to dash.js.

samples.title: Microsoft Smooth Streaming
samples.description: Shows how to use dash.js to play Microsoft Smooth Streaming streams.

samples.title: UMD ES5
samples.description: Uses the legacy build that is transpiled to ES5, with missing functionality polyfilled by core-js. The Babel target for the build is IE11.

samples.title: UMD browserslist
samples.description: Uses the modern UMD build that targets a default "browserslist". No polyfills are added to the build.

samples.title: ESM browserslist
samples.description: Uses the modern ECMAScript Module build that targets a default "browserslist". No polyfills are added to the build.

samples.title: MediaPlayer only
samples.description: Shows how to use the dash.mediaplayer bundle. This bundle does not contain any code for playback of DRM protected content.
